summary: STALE-STUDY-REVIEW was drift in one of the study review's nineteen sealed inputs: the leaf-local format.tex, shared by the three entrypoints, gained two page-1 environments (concisemaptable, conciseoverview) from the concise author after study-review accepted the study at iteration 1, so the accepted bytes d7cba8a2 no longer matched. The current file is adopted as the study's own rather than restored, because those environments are used only by the accepted companion's page 1 and the study's own output was unaffected, and the shared-file hazard is now written into format.tex's header; restoring would have broken an accepted companion to renew a review the workflow renews by re-running it. While in these files the five standing study-review advisories were also cleared (STU-003 Gregory's parable placed in Matthew 22 without the false adjacency; STU-004 the Gradual's typographic paragraph stated as facts and the Fathers' reading rather than as the study's restraint; STU-005 and STU-006's manifest half, Theodoret, Rupert and Durandus added to the son-and-lord-of-david lane and Chrysostom and Aquinas to just-judge-merciful-hearer, every added name developed in the section that declares it; STU-007 Ps 118:135 located two verses before the antiphon's own v. 137), the Scriptural Date and Location sheet now turns between dossiers instead of splitting the Gospel's two tiers, and the two record inaccuracies the concise author reported upstream (the dossier-on-one-page claim and the eight/five component counts, which are nine and six) are corrected in research/production-review.md with an iteration-2 repair and proof section. Six substantive words were added in total. The settled proof is build/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/57-seventeenth-after-pentecost.pdf, SHA-256 92511e9c1ddc21bf09c4a5c2d57172771b9732fd0a8a8accb3c707a82f4ae877, 38 physical pages, settling in two passes and reproducing its bytes exactly from a removed auxiliary file, with a log carrying no error, warning, overfull or underfull box or rerun request; all seven fonts embedded, subsetted and Unicode-mapped; 18,923 words extracted with no replacement character; check-proper-components (artifacts/research), scripts/_proper_study.py check (content/research, --require-presentation), every check-content-preflight check the study gate names including provenance-matches-run against this run's header, check-generation-metadata and check-web-edition all passing, and a trial tools/web-edition conversion carrying the ten proper-<element-key> anchors. All 38 pages were rendered and inspected: no blank or heading-only page, no clipping, collision or missing text. Both companions still build unchanged in extent (12 and 5 pages) against the adopted format file. One research defect is reported rather than repaired: STU-006 also asks that research/interpretations.md section 3 record Aquinas among the third reading's witnesses at Super Philippenses c. 4 on 4:6, which is the research owner's file and is left for the cold reviewer to route.
